state.context: CanDo requirements require current permitted work after a domain action, source change and configured polling. The actual source below has explicit refresh and an asynchronous completion handler; page poll=5s only performs authorized GET rendering. DESIGN forbids GET polling from sending remote operations, writing data or creating schedules. WorkSources is a declared external capability with deployment-installed implementation, not an existing adapter. Its five owners must implement explicit authorized list/detail projections matching canonical completion guards and protecting private fields. A user/account ID establishes no authority: delegation must bind verified principal, team, intended owner audience, current grants and bounded expiry. Browser bearer credentials cannot be forwarded. Action values need their specified owner seal and protected record/version bindings. Both options below preserve this boundary and existing domain action guards, and neither is implemented. Supply an assessment of the tradeoffs for a compact SaaS DSL; do not presume that a classifier result proves a protocol.

freshness_owner.instructions: Which bounded freshness contract best satisfies automatic owner refresh without duplicating domain operations or expanding the language unnecessarily?

criteria.adapter: Extend the existing WorkSources capability with a bounded watch request/result: account, location filter and interval produce an opaque watch identity, expiry, sequence and initial WorkBatch; authenticated changed events carry that identity, increasing sequence and a new complete batch. The installed adapter owns source invalidation, action outcomes and periodic re-reads under current delegated grants. CanDo correlates request/watch/sequence and clears action values on expiry or unavailable evidence. This centralizes refresh but adds lease, sequencing, renewal and service delegation obligations.
criteria.session: Keep WorkSources.work and the canonical refresh mutation. Add one finite shared UI refresh-trigger contract which submits that canonical operation after completed actions, authenticated source invalidation and the configured interval while an authorized user session is active; page polling itself remains GET-only. Each POST uses the current session, existing parameters and admission checks. This avoids standing adapter leases but needs bounded browser triggers, request supersession, saved filter bindings and source-event delivery; closed sessions cannot refresh.
criteria.defer: Retain explicit refresh and mark automatic source freshness incomplete until either contract is fully specified. It avoids premature authority or UI assumptions, but does not fulfill the requested automatic action/change/poll refresh journey.

existing_automatic.instructions: Does the current authored explicit refresh plus page GET polling alone implement automatic source re-reading after an action, source invalidation and a configured interval?

criteria.true: Every required automatic refresh follows from the supplied source and existing GET contract without additional behavior.
criteria.false: At least one required automatic source refresh lacks an authored trigger or owning protocol in the supplied declarations.
